captions.detailed: A compact, handheld home-video camcorder featuring a tapered dark gray body, a front cylindrical lens barrel with a silver-rimmed focus ring, and a rectangular side display screen door. On the opposite side, it includes a simple hand strap block, and at the rear is a small rectangular viewfinder eyepiece with an adjustment wheel. The display door rotates outward along a vertical hinge, the focus ring rotates continuously around the lens, and the eyepiece diopter wheel rotates on a small transverse axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact home-video camcorder with realistic handheld proportions. It should feature a main tapered body, a front-facing lens barrel with a rotatable focus ring, a side-mounted LCD display door on a vertical hinge, and a rear viewfinder with a rotatable diopter wheel.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a tapered extrusion or box with filleted edges. Model the lens barrel and focus ring as concentric cylinders of varying diameters and lengths, applying a silver material to the outer ring. Create the side display door as a thin flat box attached via a vertical revolute joint, and represent the rear viewfinder and diopter wheel using small rectangular and cylindrical primitives connected with revolute joints.
